blueprint_topic: Management of Care — interprofessional coordination for complex pulmonary diagnostic evaluation
candidate_snapshot_warning: The stem/options/source metadata below originated from the technical selector and are retained only to identify the blocked item. Selector metadata is not clinical audit evidence and does not establish PASS.
candidate_stem: A nurse helps coordinate the diagnostic evaluation of a client with newly detected interstitial lung disease who is clinically suspected of having idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF). Which approach is supported by the ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT diagnostic guideline?

candidate_options.A: Facilitate multidisciplinary discussion among clinicians with ILD expertise, radiology, and pathology as appropriate to the case
candidate_options.B: Rely on a single serum biomarker result to distinguish IPF from other interstitial lung diseases
candidate_options.C: Have one specialty determine the diagnosis without integrating the client's clinical and imaging information
candidate_options.D: Postpone interdisciplinary review until the client has failed treatment for presumed IPF

block_reason: Fresh authoritative-source verification could not be completed. On 2026-08-20, multiple independent web searches for the current ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT IPF diagnostic guideline and the 2022 IPF update returned HTTP 503 Service Unavailable; direct open of the known ATS guideline URL and ATS master-guideline index also returned 503; an independent direct HTTPS retrieval attempt failed with temporary DNS name-resolution failure. Because currentness and the relationship between the 2018 diagnostic guideline and 2022 update could not be freshly verified, RULE 1 prohibits relying on the selector's prior FINAL_QA_PASS/source metadata as evidence.
required_to_resume: Obtain a fresh readable authoritative source from ATS/ERS/JRS/ALAT or the official guideline publication that confirms the current diagnostic recommendation for multidisciplinary discussion in newly detected ILD suspected of IPF and verifies whether/how the 2022 update modifies the relevant diagnostic pathway. Then perform claim-by-claim A/B/C/D audit, correction if needed, GitHub reread, and independent second-pass QA before FINAL_QA_PASS.
independent_second_pass: NOT PERFORMED — authoritative current-source verification is blocked.
